display.title: Mishenichnas Adar: Adding Joy with Every Mitzvah
display.summary_short: We serve Hashem with joy all year, so what does 'when Adar enters, increase in joy' add? Uncle Yossi explains that the secret of real happiness is in the mitzvos.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show for the month of Adar. Uncle Yossi explains that the Sages' words 'when Adar enters, we increase in joy' do not mean that now is the time to start being happy: it is a mitzvah to serve Hashem with joy all year long. In Adar we must add even more. How? Dovid HaMelech says in Tehillim that the commandments of Hashem gladden the heart. Imagine a great and famous king visiting your home and asking you to do something for him; how honored and happy you would be. So much more so when Hashem, the King of all kings, asks us to have a mezuzah, wear tzitzis, eat kosher, put on tefillin, keep Shabbos and give tzedakah. That is simchah shel mitzvah, the joy that comes from the mitzvah itself, and in Adar it should be greater than ever.
display.lesson: Real happiness comes from doing Hashem's mitzvos, and in Adar we add even more joy.
